title: Hudson Williams you are THAT guy #hudsonwilliams #yagacrave #yaga #he...
transcript: You expect me to believe that this man and this child are the same person? Not only that, but these two projects were filmed in the same 12 months. This man and this sweet angel baby. No. No way. No, I don't believe you. Crave just dropped our first look at Yaga, and I am goofed and gagged. I'm so excited to see this. It’s a Very different role to I think, anything you've seen Hudson do before. He's not a lead in this. He's very much a secondary character. But he's a very interesting character, and I think it's going to be thrilling. Now, we don't have a ton of information yet in terms of when we are getting yaga except I believe they did say this year. However, we do know that next Saturday, July 25th, Yaga is getting a panel at San Diego Comic Con with a sneak peek of the new AMC mystery series. And I'm hoping when they get that sneak peek, we'll also get timelines. And I assume that clip will be available, like, as soon as the panel is over, if not, while it is happening. Hudson's not gonna be at the panel, but I'm sure we'll get a lot of information outside of that. i’ll never get over this being the same person. He truly just is a chameleon.
